column3: struck by great winds and waters
should worship the great Person in the form desired by oneself
of minds agitated by the splendour of the great Person's great weapon
great Person, knowledge hidden in the Self
cosmic form of the great Person
in description of the great Person's position
we meditate on the great Person thus
with dust of the great Person's feet
seized by great transformation of love
with deep sounds of great fearful whirlpools
chief great jewels and ornaments, pebbles of gems
crown and earrings with masses of great jewels
crown and earrings of masses of great jewels, thousand locks surrounded by radiance
on a floor of great emerald
in the great darkness of delusion
O great yogi, you are the first
adorned with costly garments, ornaments, jackets, turbans
by the lustre of costly vaidurya crown and earrings
costly bed, seat, clothes, ornaments, bath, ointments, food, garlands
of great strength, moving, the great waves
lord of great glories, inner controller of the Self
other than seeing the Lord of great glories
with great glories, increased limbs, gifts
Indra and Vritra, of great valour
with drops from the ocean of the nectar of glory
like a snake in a rat's hole
in the one hand sinless holding the mountain
surrounded by serpent coils of the lord of the earth
you are glorified with eight qualities, of immeasurable fortune
great rise, the sage, cutter of the knot of the heart
from the rise of the great
tell me, those who were honoured
covered outside by eight coverings: earth and others
in the body of flesh, blood, sinews, fat, marrow, bone
in house, wife, children, wealth, relatives
in the heart being tormented, determined
of the mother, directly worthy of honour
to the mother, offence against Adhokshaja
by the mother's grace by birth alone
having heard from the mother the arrival of the matter
of the mother, food and drink eaten and so on, growing by the mother's disease
in the name of maternal uncle
touched by what the mother ate
killer of mother, killer of teacher, sinner
the Self in the Self, mind does not (fragment)
Self, lord, witness of all worlds
hell, because of being of the nature of measure
from desire for touch of measure
the Lord did not command me
to free the likes of me, a surrendered beast from the noose
becoming intoxicated at the great Soma drinking
lovely song of intoxicated honeybee swarms
resounding with the voices of intoxicated swarms of bees
sweetness, a holy place for men
sweet drinks, removing the world's stains
pure bliss, unchanging, nothing else other
bliss, made of bliss, at the end
embodiment of bliss, did not abandon long heat
flood of bliss, undivided, unobstructed knowledge
honouring, the risen moon and stars
honouring himself by himself, the semblance of the Self
root of honour, desire, fear, poverty, worry
from measure, arising, sight of substance
of one who has attained human state
human life, granting purpose though impermanent
O friend of the afflicted, remover of the fear of worldly existence, I fallen
they did not attain, thinking of my valour
me, a guest who has come, by hospitality
me, with a glance of love and laughter
mad with pride in my lordship and fortune
by maya to you who came near this
by qualities of maya, activities of mind
from mixture of qualities of maya, you appear great
mind seized by qualities of maya, in objects being real
the Self covered by maya's curtain
shown to be maya, you are one
of the maya of demon women
of those crushed by the she-demon of maya
assuming a form of the Person of maya
by mayas they wish to rise
maya-made enjoyments and lordship alone spread, thus
free of the stain of maya
in what is built by maya
one who plays with maya, child
worldly existence of maya, of the Self
by parts of life, moments and so on
eating what has begun, without pride
guru of the path for those in tamas
to those with bows raised to offer
wearing garland and wrapped, wonderful dress, the two
me, disregarding the Self by the Self
whose speed was broken by Kama, marked by whirlpools
the world of ignorance was cast off
not blessing, thus to the worshipper
do not be envious of us
of the functions of limited intellect and so on
betrayer of friends, killer of brahmanas
like friends, the fast-flowing splendour of ...
the two sages Mitra and Varuna
in the couple's act of love
I am the unborn of couples
householder should leave the pairs in front
mutually (they) chanted, sung by the three worlds
mutual untruth spoken by the ignorant
exceeding mutual friendship, they embraced with smiling pure glances
in the darkness of the great debates of false reasoning, harsh
lotus-eyed, disparaging two fish as refuge
closed eyes, sleep drunk in the Self
closed eyes, sleep drunk in the Self, in the fourth state
releasing, joined with limbs night and day
turning crown, earrings, bracelets and tinkling ornaments
turning crown, earrings, bracelets and tinkling ornaments
sung by Mukunda, marked by whirlpools, speed broken by Kama
